translations.literal: Yet at this time regional commanders Sun Yingyuan and Huang Degong commanded capital troops against the bandits and repeatedly reported great victories.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile regional commanders Sun Yingyuan and Huang Degong led capital troops against the rebels and repeatedly reported major victories.

sentences.zh: 凱旋錄功，任學亦敘復二秩。

translations.literal: On triumphant return merits were recorded; Renxue also had two ranks restored in the roster.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended and merits were recorded, Renxue had two ranks restored.

sentences.zh: 尋與左良玉、陳洪範蹙李萬慶於內鄉。

translations.literal: Soon he with Liangyu and Chen Hongfan pressed Wanqing at Neixiang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he joined Zuo Liangyu and Chen Hongfan in cornering Wanqing at Neixiang.

sentences.zh: 萬慶方降，獻忠已叛，文燦盡調河南軍援剿，獨任學留汝南。

translations.literal: Wanqing had just surrendered when Xianzhong had already rebelled; Wencan shifted all Henan troops to aid suppression, leaving only Renxue at Runan.
translations.idiomatic: Wanqing had just submitted when Xianzhong rebelled; Wencan moved every Henan unit to the relief campaign and left Renxue alone at Runan.

sentences.zh: 川貴總督李若星論文燦主撫之謬，請復任學原官，攝行大將，督察軍事。

translations.literal: Sichuan-Guizhou Governor Li Ruoxing discussed the error of Wencan's pacification policy and asked that Renxue's original office be restored, acting as great commander to oversee military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan-Guizhou Governor Li Ruoxing criticized Wencan's appeasement policy and asked that Renxue be restored to his former post to act as commander-in-chief and supervise operations.

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: The court did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused.

sentences.zh: 七月，獻忠合汝才自房縣西走，岱偕良玉追之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Xianzhong joined Ruocai and fled west from Fang County; Dai together with Liangyu pursued.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Xianzhong joined Ruocai and fled west from Fang County; Dai marched with Liangyu in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 良玉令岱為前鋒，己隨其後。

translations.literal: Liangyu made Dai the vanguard and himself followed behind.
translations.idiomatic: Liangyu put Dai in the van and followed with the main body.

sentences.zh: 至羅𤠉山，軍乏食。

translations.literal: When they reached Mount Luoying, the army lacked food.
translations.idiomatic: At Mount Luoying the army ran short of provisions.

sentences.zh: 賊伏兵要害，岱與副將劉元捷鼓勇直上，伏四起。

translations.literal: The bandits lay in ambush at a strategic point; Dai and Vice General Liu Yuanjie beat drums and charged straight up; ambushes rose on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels lay in ambush at a choke point; Dai and Vice General Liu Yuanjie led a bold charge uphill—and ambush parties rose on every side.

sentences.zh: 岱馬足掛於藤，抽刀斷之，蹶而復進，乃棄馬步鬥，久之矢盡，陷於賊，良玉軍亦大敗。

translations.literal: Dai's horse's legs caught in vines; he drew his sword and cut them free, stumbled yet advanced again, then abandoned his horse to fight on foot; after a long time his arrows were spent and he fell into the bandits' hands; Liangyu's army also suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Dai's horse became entangled in vines; he cut himself free with his sword, fell, rose, and fought on, then dismounted to fight hand to hand; when his arrows ran out he was overwhelmed, and Liangyu's army was routed as well.

sentences.zh: 事聞，任學坐褫職。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, Renxue was punished by dismissal from office.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached court, Renxue was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 十五年，言官請起廢，任學與焉，未及用而卒。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year remonstrance officials asked that dismissed men be recalled; Renxue was among them, but before he could be employed he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year censorial officials petitioned to recall dismissed officials; Renxue was on the list, but died before he could be reappointed.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：流賊之肆毒也，禍始於楊鶴，成於陳奇瑜，而熾於熊文燦、丁啟睿。

translations.literal: The commentators say: In the roaming bandits' wanton cruelty, the disaster began with Yang He, took shape with Chen Qiyu, and blazed under Xiong Wencan and Ding Qirui.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: The roving rebels' devastation began with Yang He, took definitive form under Chen Qiyu, and burned hottest under Xiong Wencan and Ding Qirui.

sentences.zh: 然練國事、鄭崇儉先罹其罰，而邵捷春、余應桂亦或死或戍。

translations.literal: Yet Lian Guoshi and Zheng Chongjian suffered punishment first, while Shao Jiechun and Yu Yinggui also died or were banished.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Lian Guoshi and Zheng Chongjian were punished first, while Shao Jiechun and Yu Yinggui met death or exile.

sentences.zh: 疆場則剿撫乖方，廟堂則賞罰不當，僨師玩寇，賊勢日張，謂非人謀不臧實使之然乎！

translations.literal: On the frontier suppression and pacification were at cross purposes; in the court rewards and punishments were misplaced; commanders failed and toyed with the enemy, and bandit power grew daily—can one say it was not truly human counsel gone wrong that made it so!
translations.idiomatic: On the frontier, suppression and appeasement worked at cross purposes; in the capital, rewards and punishments misfired; commanders blundered and treated the enemy lightly, and rebel power swelled day by day—is it not human failure that made it so!
